newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to sell Petersburg Telephone stake.
newsitem.headline: Russia to sell Petersburg Telephone stake.

text.p: Russia plans to sell a 1.2 percent stake in St Petersburg telephone company AO Peterburgskaya Telefonnaya Syet in a closed cash auction on December 11, officials said on Wednesday.

Nearly 5.60 million preference shares, converted into ordinary shares with a 1,000 rouble nominal value, will be offered in 12 lots of 466,485 shares each, the city property fund, the Federal Securities Commission and the Commodities and Stock Exchange of St Petersburg said in a joint statement.
The starting price for each share will be 5,000 roubles.
Petersburg Telephone shares closed on the Russian Trading System on Tuesday at $1.45 each.

The company's main shareholder is state telecoms holding company AO Svyazinvest, with 41.8 percent of the ordinary shares. Two foreign companies, whose names have not been announced, hold some 20 percent between them.
Petersburg Telephone's net profit in the first nine months of this year rose to 144.48 billion roubles from 90.49 billion a year earlier, according to Russian accounting standards.
Pre-tax profit rose to 197.66 billion from 149.44 billion and sales rose to 629.20 billion roubles from 356.35 billion, an official of the company's economics department said.
